outcome: RAGE protein levels in brain and heart tissues
Placental mRNA expression (RAGE, NOX2, MCP-1, p65, VCAM-1, VEGF)
cohort: Pregnant rats with intrauterine hyperglycemia induced by streptozotocin (STZ).
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in rats led to increased fetal developmental abnormalities, which correlated with elevated AGEs and RAGE levels; sRAGE treatment attenuated GDM-induced metabolic and inflammatory markers but only slightly, and not significantly, reduced the probability of fetal developmental defects.
birth_weight: Pups from the GDM group exhibited a higher average weight.
